notes.title: Content Update 06/20/2025
notes.notes:
This patch brings the following update:

- Story Mode:
  - option to exit during cutscenes.
  - auto-save
  - text update and bug fix
- Arcade Mode:
  - option to toggle hazards
  - randomized opponents
- Gameplay:
  - A regular rush parry now makes the defending character get knocked back.
  - A rush parry during when the attacking character's rush meter is empty, makes the attacker get knocked back.
  - fine-tuned character movement speed and juggle physics
  - minor bug fix
- UI
  - updated UI
  - option to randomly select stage
  - xbox controller UI support

notes.title: Patch Note 12/25/2024
notes.notes:
- in-game training menu
- reset position in training mode (start button)
- an option to exit out of character select.
- bug fix: rush parry during when getting bounced off of the ground leads to the character ending up floating after the rush parry. <- No longer rush parry-able

notes.title: Patch #02
notes.notes:
bugs:
- being able to parry while getting hit by specials and supers
- screen shake moving the camera position over time.
- jump in -> walk fw -> light normal would not let light normals to come out.
- Hana: in mirror match, her y position gets messed up after getting thrown or hit by her super.
- Zero and Jake’s jab infinites.
- character going into groggy soon after super with empty rush meter.
- corner juggle wall crash not sending opponent flying.
- not able to react on frame 1 after get up.
- arcade mode hazards canceling supers and often lead to a stuck state.
- when hit right when the super freezes opponent leads to a softlock where the opponent is still frozen and does not take damage.
- command list error (Oro and Pink)
- Oro’s Aloha Throw keeps giving damage even when not thrown. (Happens after a successful regular throw by Oro. Afterwards the opponent’s health keeps decreasing every time Oro performs Aloha Throw).
- AI cannot get out of walking jabs.
- Blazing Rush animation can be triggered multiple times.
- When being hit with multiple hitboxes (like Zero’s Plasma Beam), going from guard state to running state results in the character moving in position while still in guard animation.
- combo counter continues to increment when there is a successful hit right when the opponent gets up from a knock-down.
- online: 
	- fixed a number of corner case desync issues.
	- fixed the timer desync issue.

changes:
- increased Story Mode’s dialogue text speed.
- added How-to-Play to Arcade Mode.
- Alexander’s Tiger now has smaller and lower hit box.
- Half circle inputs are updated.
- Added parry and rush parry to the command list.
- online: added an option to choose a region between NA, EU, Asia, and Best. Best means the optimal server from the current location/network.
